task.description:
Finalize GH-595 / ISS-0628 (LUA-16 stack_trace always empty on LuaJIT 2.1). Design PASSED validation cleanly (no rework cycle, one non-blocking wording nitpick). BACKEND-DEV implemented a lua_pcall message handler that captures the stack trace while call frames are live, plus discovered and fixed two additional real issues beyond the original design: (1) lua_getinfo needed 'Sln' not 'Sl' to populate function names, (2) Lua 5.1/LuaJIT proper tail calls collapse intermediate frames, requiring the test fixtures to avoid tail-call position. BACKEND-DEV also fixed an unrelated PRE-EXISTING compile blocker in the integration test file (createSandboxedState signature mismatch, via a new StateProbe wrapper) per Unblock-Everything, and filed an incidental flaky-test finding (ISS-0629/GH-600, TC-LUA-10-03 timing flake) rather than fixing it in-scope.

TEST-RUNNER PASSED: zig build test (full suite) exit 0, zig build test-lua 91/91 (with 2 additional runs showing the KNOWN ISS-0629/GH-600 flake and nothing else), zig build test-integration-iss0625 10/10. ORCH independently re-verified via its own hands-on mutation test: reverted lua_pcall's errfunc argument to the literal 0, confirmed both TC-ISS-0625-LUA-16-int-01 and the new TC-ISS-0628-LUA-16-stacktrace-01 genuinely fail with an empty stack_trace as predicted, restored the exact original code, confirmed clean rebuild (10/10 pass again).

YOUR JOB:
1. Update CHANGELOG.md: describe the fix (LUA-16's stack_trace field now genuinely captures a live call-frame trace via a lua_pcall message handler, instead of always being empty), and note the corrected GH-595 filing (the issue itself incorrectly suggested debug.traceback, which is unreachable in the sandbox -- the actual fix uses a custom handler).
2. LUA-16 already has status IN_PROGRESS in requirements.yaml (set during the earlier GH-592 merge). Run `python3 tools/reqctl.py show LUA-16` to check current state, and if this fix is what completes its acceptance criteria (stack trace non-empty for runtime errors), set it to RELEASED via reqctl.py set-status with --implemented-in listing src/lua/executor.zig, src/lua/host_context.zig. If LUA-16's acceptance criteria need anything beyond what this fix provides, leave it IN_PROGRESS and note why in your handoff result.
3. Run `python3 tools/reqctl.py render-status`.
4. Skip retrospective (WF-03 run, no estimation.json).
5. GH-595 disposition: this issue's acceptance criteria (non-empty stack_trace, errfunc installed, new TC added, existing assertion flipped) are fully met by this run -- close it with 'Closes #595' in the PR, or a closing comment if not auto-closed.
6. GitHub Branch Management (MANDATORY Step Final): create the PR (gh pr create --base main), explain the fix and the two additional discoveries (Sln selector, tail-call frame collapse) in the body. Poll for genuine CI completion, squash-merge and delete branch, verify no orphaned branch, update project board for issue #595 (likely straight to done since it's non-UAT-scoped and fully resolved), return repo to clean main.
acceptance_criteria: LUA-16 status checked and updated appropriately via reqctl.py
PR created with clear body explaining the fix and discoveries
CI verified genuinely green (polled, not assumed)

result.summary: CHANGELOG.md updated with the ISS-0628/GH-595 fix entry (root-cause correction re: debug.traceback being unreachable in the sandbox, the errfunc/message-handler design, and the two additional discoveries: lua_getinfo 'Sln' selector requirement and proper-tail-call frame collapse). LUA-16 was already RELEASED (set during the prior GH-592/ISS-0625 merge) -- this run fixed a defect in that release rather than releasing it for the first time, so implemented_in was extended to include src/lua/host_context.zig via reqctl.py set-status (idempotent re-stamp, last_updated refreshed to 2026-08-09T01:19:57Z). docs/status/requirement_status.yaml regenerated (462 entries). No estimation.json present for this WF-03 run -- retrospective correctly skipped. PR #601 created (Closes #595), explained the fix and both discoveries in the body. First CI run showed 'Build and unit tests' FAIL; python3 tools/check_github_status.py confirmed platform operational (not an outage) so the failure was investigated directly: gh run view --log-failed identified the single failing test as TC-LUA-10-03 (src/lua/limiter_wiring_test.zig), the already-filed, already-queued ISS-0629/GH-600 pre-existing timing flake -- confirmed unrelated via git diff (file untouched by this branch, last modified by the earlier, already-merged GH-495/PR#593). Reran only the failed job (gh run rerun --failed); all 6 checks passed clean on rerun, confirming the flake and not a regression. Squash-merged via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch (merge commit d0083e131855a5859e22d8f6ae3e94d32d27cb60). Remote branch deletion verified via git ls-remote (empty) and git fetch --prune. GH-595 auto-closed (state=CLOSED, stateReason=COMPLETED) via the PR's Closes reference. Project board for issue #595 checked via tools/gh_project_status.py --target implemented then --target done -- both reported already at 'Done' (no requirement-to-scenario match in tests/simulation/scenarios/, confirming non-UAT-scoped; board had already advanced automatically on issue close). Repo returned to clean main: git checkout main, git pull --ff-only (already up to date, fast-forwarded on merge), git branch --show-current = main, git status clean, HEAD = d0083e1.
result.next_action: WF-03 run complete. PR #601 merged to main (d0083e1). GH-595 closed. Repo on clean main.
